pie_de_post: Which one steals the most from you? Tell me and follow.

slides.etiqueta: Why you can't get motivated (and it's not laziness)

slides.texto:
It's the molecule of drive: the one that pushes you to go after something.
Not pleasure. Motivation.

Endless scrolling, notifications, ultra-processed food, binge-watching.
Instant reward, zero effort. Then hard things start to feel boring.

Training, reading or working on your business feels like an uphill battle.
You don't lack discipline: your stimulation bar is set too high.

Phone out of the bedroom. First hour of the day screen-free. Notifications off except calls.
Small changes, huge effect.

Training, morning sun, finishing a hard task, a real conversation.
Effort first, reward second.
